key_insight: Regularized Score Centering stabilizes asynchronous reinforcement learning by constraining policy drift with a reverse-KL penalty.
engineering_relevance: RSC targets instability from stale-policy data and training–inference numerical mismatch, improving sample efficiency in asynchronous agent training.
method: Use score centering to remove reward-baseline effects from expected updates.
Add reverse-KL regularization between learner and behavior next-token distributions.
Optionally apply truncated importance sampling to cap token importance weights.
evidence_signal: Evaluations span dense and mixture-of-experts models on mathematical reasoning and agentic tasks; RSC with TIS leads across six agentic tasks, reporting a 14.3% improvement on AppWorld and 9.9× the strongest baseline’s score on BabyAI.
watch_item: Implementation must track behavior-policy probabilities and tune regularization; the abstract does not specify computational overhead or sensitivity to these choices.
